usual_baseline: Day-case rates of 45–74% against targets of 60%, 75% or 90%. A third of overnight stays have no clinical reason (34–39%). Common causes are pain, nausea, monitoring, drains and afternoon operating. No surgeon recorded pneumoperitoneum pressure in one unit.
fix_that_works: Adapting GIRFT advice into trust guidelines raised the day-case rate from 45% to 70%, and 77.8% at a second site [2601]. Extending day unit recovery to 9pm plus liver bed local anaesthetic raised it from 64% to 73% [2660].
fix_that_fails: No failed fix reported in these audits. Even after re-audit, rates stayed below the 90% GIRFT target, and 14-day readmission was 9% [2601].
consultant_advice: A common audit, and the causes are now well known. Only worth doing if you change something concrete: recovery hours, morning slots for older or high-BMI patients, no drains. Check coding first; hot list cases skewed one unit's GIRFT figure [2564]. Also measure readmission, not just same-day discharge.
